title: Onboard skills micro-sprint: 14-day activation + evidence log
content:
Purpose: quick, focused 14-day onboarding micro-sprint for IC hires (non-manager engineering/ops roles). Goal: get a new hire to ship a scoped small outcome, capture interview/onboarding evidence, and surface early competency gaps for a 30/60 plan.

Scope:
- Target audience: new ICs (engineer, infra, docs, support) joining via regular offer flows.
- Not intended for senior managers or extended apprenticeships. Use full 90-day playbook for those.

High-level approach:
- Week 0 (pre-start): access, small reading list, 1:1 scheduled with buddy and manager.
- Days 1-3: orientation, infra + local dev setup, first micro-ticket.
- Days 4-10: pair/ownership on tiny scoped feature or docs triage (deliverable: merged PR or published doc).
- Days 11-14: demo, feedback loop, interview-evidence capture, and manager calibration.

Deliverables (14d):
- Merged PR or published doc that touches product infra or customer workflow (clear acceptance criteria).
- Onboarding evidence log entry: short narrative + artifacts (PR link, test notes, recorded demo).
- Competency heatmap snapshot (owner fills): four axes: product fluency, codebase navigation, cross-team communication, independent execution.

Day-by-day quick plan (working checklist):
Pre-start (3–7 days before):
- Send access checklist (okta, laptop, email alias).
- Assign buddy and share intro message in #people-ops-onboard.
- Grant repo read + dev cluster sandbox.
- Pre-read: product overview (10m), infra quickstart (20m).

Day 1:
- 09:00 welcome w/ manager (30m) — objectives for 14d, ask clarifying Qs.
- 10:00 buddy setup session (60m) — local dev flow + run tests.
- 14:00 HR intro + paperwork (30m).
- End of day: short 1-paragraph plan in the onboarding doc.

Day 2-3:
- Finish dev setup, run full test-suite subset.
- Small discovery task: find related tickets/owners for the micro-ticket.
- Pair with buddy to open initial branch and design simple acceptance criteria.

Day 4-7:
- Implement micro-ticket (unit tests, docs, CI).
- Daily 15m sync with buddy; manager check-in on day 5.
- Mid-sprint demo (day 7): short async recording + notes.

Day 8-10:
- Address review feedback, iterate on tests and infra guardrails.
- Work on cross-team communication: notify core stakeholders, file any TBD runbook notes.

Day 11-13:
- Finalize deliverable, prepare demo script.
- Schedule 30m demo with manager + buddy + one cross-team reviewer.

Day 14:
- Demo + capture outcomes.
- Complete onboarding evidence log entry (see template below).
- Manager completes quick calibration and next-steps (30/60 plan kickoff).

Onboarding evidence log template (one-line fields per entry for quick ingestion):
- hire_name: (string)
- role: (string)
- start_date: (YYYY-MM-DD)
- sprint_deliverable: (PR/doc link)
- short_narrative: (2–4 sentences)
- blockers_encountered: (bulleted)
- owner_actions_to_unblock: (bulleted)
- demo_link: (recording URL)
- reviewer_notes: (manager or reviewer quick bullets)
- competency_snapshot: (list of four levels e.g. product:2/codebase:3/communication:3/execution:2)

Competency heatmap guidance (fill 1–5):
- Product fluency: understands where feature fits for customer.
- Codebase navigation: locate hotspots, run tests, submit PRs.
- Cross-team communication: synchronous + async clarity, stakeholder mapping.
- Independent execution: scopes work, flags risks, ships iteratively.

Manager quick checklist (to be done by day 14):
- Confirm access & security posture are correct.
- Confirm micro-ticket delivered with quality bar.
- Review competence snapshot, identify top 2 coaching topics for 30/60.
- Schedule 30/60 goal-setting meeting.
- Add evidence log artifact to new hire folder.

Buddy responsibilities (explicit):
- Set up dev environment and confirm on day 1.
- 15–30m daily office hours first 7 days.
- Review PRs promptly and leave actionable feedback.
- Introduce to 3 cross-functional counterparts during sprint.
- Be explicit about handoff expectations after day 14.

Interview-evidence reuse:
- Use the evidence log to populate hiring interview scorecards if follow-on hiring calibrations are needed (e.g., referral/hiring swaps).
- Sample phrasing for interview notes: "Took ownership of small infra change, navigated test flakiness by adding focused coverage, communicated rollback plan when CI flaked". Keep neutral, behavioral language.

Metrics to track for micro-sprint pilot (team-level):
- % of hires who ship micro-deliverable within 14d. Target 70% in pilot cohort.
- Median time to first merged PR.
- Number of manager escalations (blocker counts).
- Competency delta from day 3 -> day 14 (team-aggregated).

Known open questions / iteration ideas:
- Should the micro-ticket be mandatory for non-customer-facing roles? tradeoffs: build confidence vs. risk of busy-work.
- How to auto-surface evidence logs into HRIS without manual copy/paste? (see ONB-89).
- Can we bake automated reminders in the onboarding doc to ping reviewers? (explore GH action).

References + quick links:
- Confluence: Onboarding Playbooks Index (linked above).
- Template PR for micro-ticket: github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-templates/micro-ticket.md (see PR #34).
- Jira tasks: HRON-212 (pilot cohort tracking), ONB-89 (evidence syncing).
- Slack: #people-ops-onboard for announcements, #engineer-buddies for buddy matching.

Next steps (owners):
- Maya: run pilot with next engineering cohort (start 2025-12-01).
- Ethan: prototype GH action to ping reviewers (due 2025-11-28).
- Sofia: craft manager calibration rubric for day 14 (draft due 2025-11-20).

Notes to self (choppy):
- keep deliverable small. avoid infra-change that requires infra-sig.
- think about gating: hr okta steps often delay day 1 - pre-provision strongly recommended.
- capture demo as Loom so folks can watch async.

Status: DRAFT — want feedback from eng managers and people-ops by 2025-11-18.

-- end --
